titles.title: Claude fragmented UTF-8 streams expose metadata and complete structured candidates, not partial input or acknowledgements

long Claude and Codex streams keep bounded recent-ID deduplication and accept final feedback
tool state survives event-ID window turnover and duplicate completions remain harmless
event-window rollover retains malformed-event and UUID-length errors
